summary.en-US: Fill CUIMS login details, solve the CAPTCHA on-device, skip promotional interstitials, hide event or feedback interruptions, and open a cleaner LMS course directory.

version.approval_notes: CUIMS Clear is an independent student utility. It stores credentials only in Firefox storage.local. CAPTCHA images are read on-device by the extension's own unminified JavaScript (captcha-solver.js), which matches the four characters against the glyphs of the fixed font CUIMS uses (captcha-glyphs.js, generated by scripts/build-captcha-glyphs.py in the source repository); no data is uploaded and no remote code is loaded at runtime. Since 0.8.6 there is no third-party or minified code in the package. Host access is limited to students.cuchd.in and lms.cuchd.in. The LMS launcher clicks the university's own CU LMS control and follows the LMS URL without saving it. The LMS directory may fetch additional same-origin /my/courses.php pages to pair syllabus and semester-work entries. Since 0.10.6 the background fetches https://addons.mozilla.org/api/v5/addons/addon/cuims-clear/ (credentials omitted, at most every six hours) to show a 'new version is out' notice; the Update link on CUIMS pages points at AMO's own latest.xpi, so Firefox's normal install prompts apply. The extension never registers runtime.onUpdateAvailable, so Firefox's own update handling is unchanged. Since 1.0 there is a 1.0 tab (a receipt of the extension's own counts, Proxy Run, a time capsule, Semester Wrapped), all on-device with no network requests. CUIMS's My Time Table, Datesheet and Marks View are redrawn on the page from their own data; Add to calendar builds an .ics file locally and hands it to Firefox's download. The Duty Leave page read now makes one same-origin postback to its External tab, where CUIMS moved the application history. No new permissions or hosts.

release_notes.en-US: CUIMS Clear is 1.0. A new 1.0 tab: a receipt of your semester, every class day by day, a time capsule, Semester Wrapped on the last day of classes, and Proxy Run. My Time Table, Datesheet and Marks View on CUIMS are redesigned, with Add to calendar for your classes and exams. Two themes for everyone who used CUIMS Clear before 1.0: Founding 100 and Black Card. Fixed: pending duty leave shows again after CUIMS's Duty Leave redesign; one exam set outside its test week no longer cancels that week's classes; absent marks count in subject totals.
